pages.title: Infrared Spectrometer
pages.text: Infrared light through a sample: each bond swallows its own colour, and the gaps in the light name them.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Set the scan's low and high wavenumbers. The bond's band must lie inside, at least 50 cm⁻¹ from either end, and the scan no wider than 1000 cm⁻¹ (wider, and it cannot resolve it).
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 1 fluid inputs, 2 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Amino Acid Mixture, Fine Reagent, Structure Card, Tholin.
